relationships.subject: photovoltaic neurostimulator
relationships.evidence_quote: In vivo neuralgia models demonstrate significant analgesic effects, while mechanistic studies reveal the involvement of inflammatory pathway regulation and modulation of transient receptor potential vanilloid type 1 (TRPV1).

key_findings: A wireless implantable NIR-driven photovoltaic neurostimulator produced analgesia in neuralgia models.
Mechanism involved inflammatory pathway regulation and TRPV1 modulation.
